en.install: Select the registered ShowAI MCP connection in ChatGPT plugin settings. For first-time setup, add the public HTTPS MCP URL with OAuth and dynamic client registration, approve the matching request in ShowAI and refresh the session.
en.features: Show interactive MCP App previews and page cards in chat. Connections with page-opening tools can open the authorized editor from a card.

zh.install: 在 ChatGPT 的插件设置中选用已注册的 ShowAI MCP 连接。首次接入时添加可从公网访问的 HTTPS MCP 地址，选择 OAuth 和动态客户端注册，在 ShowAI 核对并批准连接后刷新会话。
zh.features: 在会话内显示 MCP App 交互预览和原页卡片。连接提供打开原页的工具时，可从卡片进入已授权的页面编辑器。
